title: Semantic-preserving local model scaling
objective: Test bounds-based variable coordinates and Gold-independent residual equilibration as local-model transformations while preserving the public black-box DSL, semantic residuals, canonical validation and target truth.
hypothesis: Bounds midpoint/half-width coordinates and a frozen upper-quartile residual scale will improve fixed-start Gold recall or charged expected work on ill-scaled systems without changing semantic convergence or introducing representation-dependent decisions.

included: one-to-sixteen-variable C0 black-box square and overdetermined systems whose every physical bound is safe finite binary64 l < u with finite midpoint and positive half-width
the current dense finite-difference LM-QR step with fixed starts
semantic, bounds-coordinate, model-residual and combined scaling ablations
canonical and independent Gold assessment outside the candidate process
excluded: analytic or automatic Jacobian routing, sparse QR and local-algorithm switching
start-policy changes, target-aware calibration, deflation and singular certification
wire-format, RelationObservation, plugin ABI or geometry-primitive changes
any reuse of EXP-LOCAL-001 or EXP-LOCAL-002 inputs for selection

literature.claim: Moré gives a robust Levenberg-Marquardt implementation whose stated features include implicit variable scaling and a safeguarded damping parameter.
literature.assumptions: A continuously differentiable nonlinear least-squares model and meaningful local linearization.
literature.break_conditions: Opaque C0 paths, invalid domains, singular roots and a scaling rule that changes problem semantics.

literature.claim: Ruiz analyzes iterative row-and-column matrix equilibration and proves convergence under stated matrix-pattern conditions.
literature.assumptions: A fixed finite matrix with the pattern and norm conditions required by the report.
literature.break_conditions: A sampled nonlinear residual model is not the Ruiz algorithm, and branch or domain changes can invalidate a fixed local matrix interpretation.

literature.claim: Moré, Garbow and Hillstrom provide a broad test-function collection and reliability-oriented guidance for optimization software testing.
literature.assumptions: The benchmark instances and starting points expose the numerical behavior being claimed.
literature.break_conditions: A small convenient subset or post-outcome representation choice cannot support general robustness claims.

literature.claim: Higham separates residual evaluation, Jacobian formation and linear-solve error when analyzing limiting Newton accuracy.
literature.assumptions: The local Newton model and error bounds describe the executed residual and linear algebra.
literature.break_conditions: A small model residual alone does not establish forward accuracy or a correct target under poor conditioning.

literature.claim: COCO advocates fixed-target, budget-aware empirical comparisons rather than best-run summaries.
literature.assumptions: Targets, budgets, instances and charged cost are fixed before execution.
literature.break_conditions: Ignoring calibration, failed starts, compilation or post-hoc thresholds biases runtime and recall comparisons.

controls.description: Use declared variable origin/scale and semantic residual z_i = y_i / s_i; all step, convergence and validation behavior is otherwise current LM-QR.

candidates.description: Replace only variable coordinates by finite-bounds midpoint and half-width coordinates while retaining semantic residual z.
Use q_i = z_i / a_i only for LM merit, Jacobian, step and predicted-versus-actual acceptance; internal termination, endpoint replay and Gold assessment continue to use z.
Combine LX bounds coordinates with LR model-only residual equilibration without changing semantic observations.

synthetic_families.purpose: Expose residual row-scale spread while preserving an independently constructed regular root.
counterexample_for: semantic scaling is sufficient for every row-scale pattern

synthetic_families.purpose: Exercise narrow curved valleys where model conditioning and accepted-step prediction interact.
counterexample_for: linear scaling gains transfer automatically to nonlinear valleys

synthetic_families.purpose: Measure scaling near unstable rank transitions without claiming singular-root support.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Constructed SVD factors and analytic configurations
counterexample_for: small model residual implies accurate configuration

synthetic_families.purpose: Separate true-root capture from positive-residual least-squares stationarity.
counterexample_for: package convergence is a root predicate

synthetic_families.purpose: Stress close geometric intersections and near-tangent conditioning.
Detect transformations that improve one basin while losing other correct targets.
synthetic_families.gold_source: Invertible analytic warp of independent roots and targets
counterexample_for: aggregate local success preserves all-target coverage

synthetic_families.purpose: Ensure local model scaling never weakens strict guard or boundary semantics.
Require the complete experiment to operate through an opaque C0 black-box callback.
counterexample_for: scaling requires polynomial lowering or automatic differentiation

real_problem_policy: Each candidate case contains only an independently random opaque_case_key, sanitized problem/plugin payload required to construct the actual compiler/oracle, public finite bounds/origin/scale/semantic relation scales, persisted calibration points, starts and budgets. No candidate-visible field identifies or links a latent group or representation. The generator-only tree holds the independent calibration_key used to create a latent group's base points; it is never copied to the candidate tree. The assessor-only tree contains Gold configurations/targets/tolerances, family/latent-group/representation maps and branch/analytic truth. The execution harness may construct the oracle from the sanitized payload, but solver and calibrator receive only that oracle plus public numeric metadata and the persisted points, never specification, plugin, problem, family, latent-group or representation IDs.

execution_order: C-1: commit the final card and human documentation with no EXP-LOCAL-003 generator, mechanism, input or result
C0: commit generator, materializer, independent assessor, schemas, environment lock and a numeric-JSON-domain fixture, with no candidate mechanism
C1: materialize candidate and assessor-only Gold development trees exactly once, bind every file and environment hash, then make both trees immutable
C2: commit the candidate mechanism, tests and exact L0 default-equivalence evidence without opening either outcome tree

C3: from a clean C2 worktree, run the candidate process exactly once with only the candidate tree, then hash and seal its complete raw output before that process exits; only afterward, in a separate assessor process, open the assessor-only tree, verify the seal, assess the frozen Safety16/bootstrap statistics and publish the decision
If and only if C3 is protocol-valid and passes every gate, materialize 96 generator-disjoint locked cases and run only the single frozen development champion against L0
design.pairing: Each of eight families has two latent groups and three semantic-equivalent representations, giving 48 cases. All variants share each case, start order, calibration block, local budget and canonical replay; representation replicates remain inside their latent-group cluster.
design.freeze_rule: There is no tuning. Formulae, thresholds, case descriptors, order statistics, counter domains/seeds, fallbacks, budgets, bootstrap, champion ordering and assessment code freeze at C0 before the one-shot C1 materialization. A protocol or infrastructure failure at C1, C2 or C3 is terminal for this experiment and authorizes no retry.
design.locked_validation_rule: Only a valid passing C3 may materialize four new latent groups per family with the same three primary representations, giving 96 locked cases. Replacement is allowed only for mechanically detected pre-outcome input invalidity before any locked outcome is visible. Once any locked outcome is visible, every failure stands: no replacement, retry, reselection or threshold change is allowed.
notes: Calibration uses only safe finite public bounds l_j < u_j. For each latent group's base point p=0..63 and coordinate j=0..d-1, H=SHA-256(domain || seed32 || calibration_key32 || uint32be(p) || uint32be(j)); n=uint64be(H[0:8])>>12 is the top 52 bits and the exact dyadic open-unit value is u=(2n+1)*2^-53, whose range is 2^-53 through prevfloat(1). The calibration_key is independent generator-only randomness, not any candidate-visible key.

The calibration counter domain is the NUL-terminated ASCII geotarget.exp-local-003.calibration.counter.v1 and its seed is SHA-256 of ASCII EXP-LOCAL-003-CALIBRATION-SEED-V1. Under locked IEEE-754 binary64 roundTiesToEven semantics, compute d=u_j-l_j; if d is finite set halfwidth=d/2 and midpoint=l_j+halfwidth, otherwise set halfwidth=u_j/2-l_j/2 and midpoint=l_j/2+u_j/2. Require finite midpoint and finite positive halfwidth, compute t=fma(2.0,u,-1.0), and define x=fma(halfwidth,t,midpoint), both through the explicit correctly rounded Base.fma(Float64,Float64,Float64) contract. The environment lock and C0 fixture pin Base.fma behavior; C0 rejects a case if any resulting x is nonfinite or outside l_j <= x_j <= u_j.

The base counter has no Gold, root, start, outcome, family or representation input. C0 creates each other representation's points by its deterministic coordinate transform of the latent base points, then persists each case's exact point bytes and checksum in the candidate tree. Solver and calibrator receive only those persisted case points and may not see calibration_key, regenerate, replace or select points. Thus representation descriptors affect only the C0 transform, never the base counter.

For each latent group, base, deterministic signed variable/residual permutation, and semantic-equivalent row rescaling form a hard metamorphic triple. Row multipliers are exact powers of two; C0 rejects any transform producing overflow, underflow, subnormal y_i/s_i operands or loss of exact z equality.

For every variant and paired start, canonical and Gold decisions must agree across the three primary representations after inverse mapping, and each LR/LXR calibration scale vector must equal its expected residual permutation. Any disagreement is a zero-required development failure.

Safety16 is one preregistered orthogonal representation per latent group with expected_invariant=false. It is report-only and excluded from development statistics; any disagreement forbids product connection but neither selects a candidate nor changes the C3 development statistic.

At a prefix, a latent-group recall effect is the mean of paired candidate-minus-L0 binary Gold-valid start decisions across all three primary representations. The overall effect is the equal-weight mean of the 16 latent-group effects; family effects and positive-family count are descriptive only. For the selected prefix-32 recall-path candidate, a positive family means family recall delta >0. For a selected efficiency-only candidate, it means family recall delta >=-0.02 and family ERT reduction >0. These two positivity comparisons are strict >0 even though other frozen threshold equalities pass.

Charged ERT for selected bootstrap group records pools all charged work and all Gold-valid successes and is +Inf when the pooled success count is zero. At each prefix 8, 16 and 32, every selected LR or LXR case charges exactly one complete 64-observation calibration to that prefix's numerator, including invalid observations; prefixes do not amortize one another. L0 and LX execute no calibration and charge zero calibration work. Common input-point materialization cost is excluded from oracle-work ERT and reported once in the end-to-end secondary metric, so it is never double charged.

For ERT reduction let B be L0 ERT and C candidate ERT, with every finite B strictly positive. The frozen extended-real rule is 1-C/B when both are finite, 1 when B=+Inf and C is finite, -Inf when B is finite and C=+Inf, and 0 when both are +Inf. The corresponding candidate/L0 ratio is C/B when finite, 0 for B=+Inf with finite C, and +Inf whenever C=+Inf, including +Inf/+Inf, so the indeterminate case cannot pass the overhead gate. Numeric JSON forbids nonstandard numeric literals and encodes extended values as the tagged strings "+Inf" and "-Inf".

Inference uses exactly 100000 deterministic paired family-stratified bootstrap replicates. Within each of eight families, resample that stage's latent groups with replacement, preserving each selected group's paired representations/starts. The persisted bootstrap index bytes and SHA-256 are authority.

Bootstrap draw H=SHA-256(domain || seed || stage-byte || uint32be(replicate) || uint32be(family) || uint32be(draw) || uint32be(rejection)); stage-byte is ASCII D for development or L for locked, all indexes are zero-based, G is 2 development or 4 locked groups per family, n is the first uint64be word, limit=2^64-(2^64 mod G), n>=limit retries with rejection+1, otherwise index=n mod G. Domain is NUL-terminated ASCII geotarget.exp-local-003.bootstrap.counter.v1 and seed is SHA-256 of ASCII EXP-LOCAL-003-BOOTSTRAP-SEED-V1.

A frozen replacement namespace may be consumed only inside the C1 or locked one-shot materialization transaction when the materializer detects a preregistered input invariant failure before sealing and before any outcome exists. It is recorded as input replacement, not an execution retry; no sealed input is replaced.

A one-sided 95 percent lower bound is sorted bootstrap item 5000 and upper bound is item 95000, both one-indexed nearest-rank among 100000 replicates. Every gate threshold comparison is inclusive so exact equality passes, except the two explicitly strict family-positivity tests recall delta >0 and ERT reduction >0.

If multiple candidates pass development, candidates passing the recall path outrank efficiency-only candidates. Recall-path order is descending lower recall bound, ascending charged ERT, then LX before LR before LXR. Efficiency-path order is descending lower ERT-reduction bound, descending recall effect, then the same simplicity order. This lexicographic rule selects exactly one candidate without tuning.

The selected candidate alone enters locked validation against L0; locked assessment repeats the frozen safety, recall and ERT gates without reselection. Recall thresholds are absolute probability-point differences; ERT thresholds are relative fractions.
The schema-required RB0 baseline ID names the historical M0-M4 lineage; L0-SEMANTIC is the actual current control and its differences from raw RB0 are explicit.
LR calibration accepts a point only when the complete observation vector is status-valid and every z_i is finite; componentwise partial observations are discarded.

Each case record contains K, every r_i and a_i in binary64 hex, canonical a-vector SHA-256, joint-fallback reason and per-component lower/upper clamp reasons. The a vector is computed once per case and cannot depend on variant outcomes.
Any nonfinite q=z/a is EVAL_NONFINITE and a model failure. It never satisfies semantic convergence, never replaces the last finite semantic observation and never becomes a candidate endpoint.

The additional a_i and q_i never enter RelationObservation, protocol wire or checkpoints. Finite differences evaluate unchanged RelationObservation values and form J_z for z; only after differencing is J_q=diag(1/a)J_z formed. q and J_q are used only for model merit, LM step and predicted-versus-actual step acceptance; internal termination/convergence and endpoint replay use z. No finite-difference observation is rewritten and LX changes only internal coordinates before returning physical coordinates.

At C0, capture the LocalSolveOptions source hash and the exact constructor result: integer max_iterations/max_evaluations and binary64 hexadecimal residual_tolerance, step_tolerance, finite_difference_step, initial_damping, damping_increase and damping_decrease. Every variant and representation receives those identical frozen values, and the candidate mechanism may not alter or reinterpret them.
The opaque unknown-plugin Float64-only C0 path is mandatory. Neither polynomial lowering nor analytic/automatic derivatives may be required by L0, LX, LR or LXR.

calibration_point_count.rationale: Fixed Gold-independent coverage for one charged model scale estimate.
calibration_point_count.freeze_rule: Generate independently of starts and persist before execution.

calibration_nearest_rank.rationale: A deterministic upper-quartile magnitude without interpolation ambiguity.
calibration_nearest_rank.freeze_rule: For each component sort absolute z values from complete valid vectors only and name the selected nearest-rank value r_i.

minimum_valid_calibration_vectors.rationale: Avoid component scales inferred from accidental finite samples.
minimum_valid_calibration_vectors.freeze_rule: If K is below eight, or any r_i is nonfinite or nonpositive, set every a_i to one jointly.

model_scale_binary64_clamp.rationale: Exact power-of-two bounds prevent unusable model magnitudes without changing semantic z.
model_scale_binary64_clamp.freeze_rule: When joint fallback does not fire, set a_i=clamp(r_i,2^-40,2^40) once per case and share the frozen vector between LR and LXR.

bootstrap_replicates.rationale: Fixes nearest-rank one-sided clustered bounds without regenerated randomness.
bootstrap_replicates.freeze_rule: Persist the exact family-stratified index matrix and hash before assessment.

starts_per_case.rationale: Supports paired basin recall at fixed prefixes.
starts_per_case.freeze_rule: Persist the complete ordered matrix before execution.

local_maxiters.rationale: Matches the current dense LM-QR control budget.
local_maxiters.freeze_rule: Identical for every variant and representation.

local_max_evaluations.rationale: Matches the current LocalSolveOptions per-start evaluation cap.
local_max_evaluations.freeze_rule: Identical for every variant and representation; the separate 64 calibration observations do not consume this cap.

recall_noninferiority_margin.rationale: Maximum tolerated recall loss for an efficiency claim.
recall_noninferiority_margin.freeze_rule: Apply to every mandatory prefix and critical family.

ert_reduction_fraction.rationale: Minimum charged expected-work reduction at noninferior recall.
ert_reduction_fraction.freeze_rule: Calibration and failed starts remain charged.

ert_recall_gain_max_overhead_fraction.rationale: Bounds the work cost accepted for a material recall gain.
ert_recall_gain_max_overhead_fraction.freeze_rule: Apply only to the recall-gain path.

minimum_positive_family_count.rationale: Requires path-specific descriptive breadth across unrelated mechanisms.
minimum_positive_family_count.freeze_rule: At prefix 32 use recall delta >0 for a recall-path candidate; for an efficiency-only candidate require recall delta >=-0.02 and ERT reduction >0. Both positivity tests are strict.

budgets.accounting: Each start has hard caps of 250 local iterations and 2000 local evaluations. At every prefix independently charge exactly one complete 64-observation calibration for each selected LR/LXR case, including invalid calibration observations, plus residual/Jacobian calls, factorization, rejected steps, canonical replay, Gold assessment, compilation, allocations and full failed-start budgets; no prefix amortizes calibration from another prefix. Calibration observations are separate charged work and do not consume the per-start 2000-evaluation cap. L0 and LX perform no calibration and charge zero calibration observations. Primary ERT pools primal-equivalent oracle work and Gold-valid successes in selected latent-group records, using +Inf for zero successes. The common C1 input-point materialization itself is excluded from every variant's oracle-work ERT and counted once in end_to_end_cpu_seconds; process CPU and formal wall are secondary.

seeds.generation: One namespace per latent group and disjoint namespaces for parameters, representations, calibration, starts, bootstrap and Gold. Calibration and bootstrap use the exact SHA-256 counter domains/seeds frozen in this card; persisted point and index bytes plus checksums, not seeds alone, are replay authority.

primary.definition: Fraction of fixed starts ending at a canonical-valid independently matched Gold configuration and target.

secondary.definition: For selected latent-group records, pooled charged primal-equivalent work divided by pooled Gold-valid successes. Each selected LR/LXR case charges its full 64-observation calibration independently at that prefix, including invalid observations; L0/LX charge zero calibration; +Inf applies when no success occurs.
Report-only process CPU for one-shot input preparation, execution and assessment, counting common C1 input-point materialization exactly once; it is not included in oracle-work ERT.

Prefix-32 descriptive count for the selected candidate. On the recall path count families with family recall delta >0; on the efficiency-only path count families with recall delta >=-0.02 and family ERT reduction >0. The positivity tests are strict and this is never an inferential sample size.
Charged process CPU time reported separately from oracle work.
Host-observed formal wall time, secondary and invalid whenever host exclusion fails.

safety.definition: Endpoints accepted despite failing canonical or independent Gold configuration/target truth.
Any change to z, raw/scale/scaled observations, relation truth, guards, domains, branches, target or public wire bytes caused by model scaling.
Gold values, assessor tolerances, problem IDs or family names observed by candidate calibration, routing or steps.
Attempts or calibration work exceeding a declared hard budget.

Per-variant canonical/Gold decision disagreement after inverse mapping across base, signed-permutation and exact semantic-row-rescaling replicas, including an incorrectly permuted calibration scale vector.
Missing or incorrect point/scale hash, K, joint-fallback reason, clamp reason, or nonfinite-q model-failure classification.
Safety16 decision disagreements under frozen orthogonal representations with expected_invariant=false; report-only and excluded from development inference.

criteria: False-candidate, semantic/wire drift, Gold/identity leak, budget-overrun, primary-representation-disagreement and calibration-audit-failure counts are exactly zero.
At prefixes 8, 16 and 32, the candidate-minus-L0 overall recall-delta one-sided 95 percent lower bound is at least -0.02, inclusive, and no critical family has a descriptive point delta below -0.02.

At prefix 32, one candidate either has recall point delta at least 0.05, recall-delta lower bound at least 0.00 and candidate/L0 charged-ERT ratio at most 1.10, or has recall-delta lower bound at least -0.02 and one-sided 95 percent lower bound on relative charged-ERT reduction at least 0.20. Equality passes every comparison.

At prefix 32 the selected candidate has positive_family_count at least three of eight: a recall-path candidate counts only family recall delta >0; an efficiency-only candidate counts only family recall delta >=-0.02 together with family ERT reduction >0. The two >0 comparisons are strict; the count does not replace latent-group inference.
The opaque C0 and strict-guard families pass without analytic/AD capability, family routing or semantic fallback.
The frozen lexicographic rule selects exactly one passing development champion; only that candidate may enter locked validation against L0, where the same gates repeat without reselection.
Safety16 is published separately with expected_invariant=false and no orthogonal-invariance claim. Any disagreement forbids product connection but does not alter development selection statistics.
Any candidate changes semantic z, RelationObservation, wire data or canonical/Gold acceptance semantics.
Any calibration or step reads Gold, assessor tolerances, problem identity or family identity.
Any candidate introduces a canonical false candidate, hard-budget overrun, calibration audit failure or primary-representation disagreement.
Any semantic row multiplier is not an exact power of two, or produces overflow, underflow, a subnormal operand or nonidentical z.
Any nonfinite q is treated as convergence, retained as an endpoint, or handled as anything other than EVAL_NONFINITE model failure.
Every candidate fails both the recall-gain and recall-noninferior charged-ERT paths.
The opaque C0 family requires polynomial lowering, analytic derivatives or an unavailable plugin capability.
C1, C2 or C3 has a protocol or infrastructure failure; the experiment terminates without retry or locked materialization.

safety_invariants: Semantic residual z_i is always RelationObservation.scaled = raw/semantic-scale and is never replaced by model residual q_i.
The a_i and q_i vectors exist only in an experiment-local numerical model and never in DSL, plugin, wire or checkpoint state.
A calibration sample is valid only as a complete observation vector; fallback is all components together.
Calibration points are persisted physical configurations generated only from safe public finite bounds by the frozen counter mapping; their bytes, K, scale vector and reasons are hash-bound.
Primary semantic-equivalent representations are a hard exact agreement gate; orthogonal Safety16 has expected_invariant=false and is report-only.
All variants receive identical ordered starts and no start is suppressed by an earlier result.
Solver status and q are never answer predicates; internal termination and unchanged canonical replay use z, and independent Gold decides correctness.
Candidate source imports no assessor tree and solver/calibrator route on no specification, plugin, problem, family, representation, primitive or target identity.

The mandatory geometry-DSL path is candidate ProblemSpec generated by the Python SDK ProblemBuilder plus canonical encoder/validator (never handwritten JSON) -> candidate problem document -> decode_problem_document -> allowlisted FrozenPluginRegistry -> compile_problem -> evaluate(compiled, C0) callback -> local solver -> evaluate_canonical/validate_candidate; DirectAnalyticProblem and hand-built RelationObservation substitutes are forbidden.
No product connection or locked input materialization occurs before every development gate passes, and no observed locked failure is replaced or retried.
